citations.assessment: The Mishnah lists Elyoeini, Chanamel and Yishmael together in that order, with one heifer each. It supplies no absolute dating for the contemporaries.

holds.raw: בימיו אליועיני בן הקף וחוני המעגל ור' יהודה בן טבאי ושמעון בן שטח (צ"ע)
holds.reason: Parah supplies a ritual roster. Sefer Yuchasin supplies a separate chronology. These witnesses do not establish all the contemporaries listed and questioned here.

notes.text: Mishnah Parah lists the high priests’ heifers. Yuchasin gives the attributed Hillel and Yochanan chronology. Preserve Heilprin’s explicit chronological question.
